mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, config_type, config_code FROM batch.config_cache_invalidation_outbox WHERE next_attempt_at <= clock_timestamp() AND (claim_until IS NULL OR claim_until <= clock_timestamp()) ORDER BY next_attempt_at, id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE batch.config_cache_invalidation_outbox SET claim_token = #{token}::uuid, claim_until = clock_timestamp() + interval '60 seconds', attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM batch.config_cache_invalidation_outbox WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND claim_token = #{token}::uuid
mapper.update: UPDATE batch.config_cache_invalidation_outbox SET claim_token = NULL, claim_until = NULL, next_attempt_at = clock_timestamp() + interval '5 seconds' WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND claim_token = #{token}::uuid
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batch.config_cache_invalidation_outbox (tenant_id, config_type, config_code) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{type}, #{code})
